label: Micro-Abrasive Blasting Unit
description: A precision instrument that uses a stream of abrasive powder propelled by compressed air to gently 'erase' rock matrix from fossil surfaces.

components.function: Holds the media used for blasting; different hardness levels are used for different rock types.
A pencil-sized handpiece that directs the abrasive stream.
Allows the preparator to toggle the flow of powder while keeping both hands on the specimen.
Protects the user while allowing a clear view of the work.
Connects to the vacuum system to prevent the cabinet from becoming opaque with dust.

game_mechanics.media_selection: Player must choose the correct abrasive hardness. If the powder is harder than the fossil (Mohs scale), the fossil takes damage.
game_mechanics.visibility_management: If the player doesn't clear the dust, the screen becomes 'foggy,' increasing the risk of over-blasting.
game_mechanics.pressure_regulation: High PSI removes rock faster but risks 'pitting' the bone surface.
